decision_record.title: G24 predicate authority architecture
decision_record.decision: Approve the exact frozen R75 predicate-authority architecture as the governing basis for a separate local machine-contract design and verification gate.
rationale: mechanical truth, normative human judgement and deterministic derivation need distinct legitimate owners
an LLM may support evidence work but cannot create truth, satisfy a precondition or grant authority
complete current evidence, revocation and correction are mandatory for consequential decisions
technical rigor must preserve a simple one-question human experience

alternatives.reason_rejected: a signed boolean can launder incomplete meaning, stale evidence or the wrong authority

alternatives.route: LLM interpretation of prose as predicate authority
alternatives.reason_rejected: fluency and confidence are not authority

alternatives.route: one internal database owns every truth species
alternatives.reason_rejected: human judgement and external canonical facts have different legitimate owners
R75 cleared all seven roles and remaining uncertainty belongs in the machine-contract proof

decision_record.dissent: The chosen route creates substantial cross-system consistency, revocation, repair and fixture complexity compared with a conventional LLM wrapper.
tradeoffs: accept more hidden implementation rigor to avoid false authority
hold safely when a canonical source cannot prove current authority
require explicit human judgement where meaning cannot be discovered mechanically

evidence_refs.role: seven-role review clearance and authority boundary

assumptions.belief: The R75 meanings can be represented as a modular executable contract without weakening the one-question human experience.
assumptions.flip_rule: A reproducible machine-contract counterexample shows that preserving one invariant necessarily violates another.

revisit.trigger: A reproducible machine-contract counterexample cannot preserve R75 without contradiction, or a later named proof falsifies an inherited authority, safety or human-value assumption.
revisit.signal_source: G24 machine-contract fixtures, deterministic checker and seven-role adjudication
revisit.action_when_fired: Set the decision to review_due and prepare a keep, supersede or reverse brief.

decision_record.authority_granted: Versioned local machine-contract design, deterministic verification, adversarial fixtures, independent review, local documentation and local commits only.
